target.statement: Random Forest 10-fold cross-validation accuracy of 0.984 for 3-class (authentic honey / sugar syrup / adulterated honey) classification using mineral element profiles
target.dataset: Public honey mineral element dataset (429 instances, 13 variables; from Liu et al. 2021, Food Chemistry 343:128455)

compute.basis: Tiny tabular dataset (429x13) with standard sklearn models (LR/DT/RF) and 10-fold CV; the only real work is locating the underlying public dataset and re-implementing the trivial preprocessing (ND->0, min-max) and CV protocol.

blockers: No code or configs released; preprocessing and CV protocol must be re-implemented from the text

Dataset is not hosted by the authors and must be sourced from the cited prior work (Liu et al. 2021) or a repository; exact file/version and class-label construction (pure/syrup/adulterated) must be inferred
Exact RF hyperparameters and random seed are unspecified, so exact 0.984 may not be bit-reproducible
title: A Machine Learning Approach for Honey Adulteration Detection using Mineral Element Profiles
